  76def find_git_repo_root(start_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None) -> Path:
  77    """Discovers the root directory of the current Git repository using `git rev-parse`."""
  78    target = Path(start_dir or os.getcwd()).resolve()
  79    try:
  80        res = run_git_in_repo(target, ["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])
  81        if res.returncode == 0 and res.stdout.strip():
  82            return Path(res.stdout.strip()).resolve()
  83    except Exception:
  84        pass
  85
  86    curr = target
  87    while curr != curr.parent:
  88        if (curr / ".git").exists():
  89            return curr
  90        curr = curr.parent
  91
  92    raise TargetRepositoryNotFoundError(
  93        f"ERROR: no target Git repository found in '{target}'. HowlPlane must be run inside a Git repository."
  94    )

  97def find_control_plane_root(override_path: Optional[str] = None) -> Path:
  98    """Discovers the HowlPlane repository path using the 5-step precedence."""
  99    if override_path:
 100        p = Path(override_path).expanduser().resolve()
 101        if (p / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
 102            return p
 103        raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(
 104            f"ERROR: specified HowlPlane control plane path does not exist: {override_path}"
 105        )
 106
 107    # 1. Primary canonical environment variable: HOWLPLANE_HOME / HOWLPLANE_DIR
 108    env_path = os.environ.get("HOWLPLANE_HOME") or os.environ.get("HOWLPLANE_DIR")
 109    if env_path:
 110        p = Path(env_path).expanduser().resolve()
 111        if (p / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
 112            return p
 113        raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(
 114            f"ERROR: HOWLPLANE_HOME environment variable points to invalid path: {env_path}"
 115        )
 116
 117    # 2. Deprecated legacy environment variable: AI_KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY
 118    legacy_env = os.environ.get("AI_KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY")
 119    if legacy_env:
 120        p = Path(legacy_env).expanduser().resolve()
 121        if (p / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
 122            print(
 123                "WARNING: AI_KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY environment variable is deprecated; please use HOWLPLANE_HOME instead.",
 124                file=sys.stderr,
 125            )
 126            return p
 127        raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(
 128            f"ERROR: legacy AI_KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY environment variable points to invalid path: {legacy_env}"
 129        )
 130
 131    # 3. Config file candidates (canonical ~/.config/howlplane/ followed by legacy fallbacks)
 132    candidates = [
 133        Path.home() / ".config" / "howlplane" / "config.toml",
 134        Path.home() / ".config" / "ai-control-plane" / "config.toml",
 135        Path.home() / ".config" / "ai" / "config.toml",
 136    ]
 137    for cfg in candidates:
 138        if cfg.is_file():
 139            try:
 140                txt = cfg.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
 141                match = re.search(r'path\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']', txt)
 142                if match:
 143                    p = Path(match.group(1)).expanduser().resolve()
 144                    if (p / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
 145                        return p
 146                    raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(f"ERROR: configured path in '{cfg}' is invalid: {match.group(1)}")
 147            except ControlPlaneNotFoundError:
 148                raise
 149            except Exception:
 150                pass
 151
 152    # 4. Self repository root detection
 153    self_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
 154    if ((self_root / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (self_root / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir()) and (self_root / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
 155        return self_root
 156
 157    raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(
 158        "ERROR: configured HowlPlane control plane not found.\n"
 159        "Please set the HOWLPLANE_HOME environment variable or configure ~/.config/howlplane/config.toml:\n\n"
 160        "  [control_plane]\n"
 161        "  path = \"/path/to/howlplane\"\n"
 162    )

 165def _resolve_repo(args: argparse.Namespace) -> Path:
 166    target = getattr(args, "repo", None) or getattr(args, "repo_dir", None) or getattr(args, "project_dir", None)
 167    return find_git_repo_root(target)

 170def _resolve_ledger_file(args: argparse.Namespace, cp_root: Optional[Path] = None) -> Optional[str]:
 171    explicit = getattr(args, "ledger_file", None)
 172    if explicit:
 173        return explicit
 174    if cp_root is None:
 175        try:
 176            cp_root = find_control_plane_root(getattr(args, "control_plane_dir", None))
 177        except Exception:
 178            return None
 179    ledger_path = cp_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "evidence_ledger.jsonl"
 180    return str(ledger_path)

 183def infer_task_metadata(
 184    objective: str,
 185    repo_name: str,
 186    explicit_id: Optional[str] = None,
 187    explicit_risk: Optional[str] = None,
 188    explicit_tier: Optional[str] = None,
 189    explicit_class: Optional[str] = None,
 190) -> Tuple[str, str, str, str]:
 191    """Infers task ID, task class, risk level, and reasoning tier from objective text."""
 192    clean_obj = objective.strip()
 193    lowered = clean_obj.lower()
 194
 195    if explicit_id:
 196        task_id = explicit_id
 197    else:
 198        issue_match = re.search(r'(?:issue|bug|item|task)\s*#?\s*([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)', clean_obj, re.IGNORECASE)
 199        if issue_match:
 200            issue_val = issue_match.group(1).upper()
 201            if issue_val.startswith("TASK-") or issue_val.startswith("IMP-") or issue_val.startswith("ISSUE-"):
 202                task_id = issue_val
 203            else:
 204                pfx = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', repo_name).upper()[:8] or "TASK"
 205                task_id = f"{pfx}-{issue_val}"
 206        else:
 207            h_suf = hashlib.sha256(f"{repo_name}:{clean_obj}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:6].upper()
 208            pfx = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', repo_name).upper()[:8] or "TASK"
 209            task_id = f"{pfx}-{h_suf}"
 210
 211    if explicit_class:
 212        task_class = explicit_class
 213    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["security", "vuln", "auth", "cve", "patch", "exploit"]):
 214        task_class = "security_patch"
 215    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["fix", "bug", "crash", "error", "defect", "broken", "fail"]):
 216        task_class = "bug_fix"
 217    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["refactor", "clean", "simplify", "restructure"]):
 218        task_class = "refactor"
 219    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["test", "falsif", "mock", "assert", "coverage"]):
 220        task_class = "test"
 221    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["doc", "readme", "comment", "guide"]):
 222        task_class = "documentation"
 223    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["deploy", "infra", "terraform", "helm", "k8s", "docker"]):
 224        task_class = "infrastructure"
 225    else:
 226        task_class = "feature"
 227
 228    if explicit_risk:
 229        risk_level = explicit_risk
 230    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["critical", "production", "deploy", "terraform apply", "drop table", "credential", "secret"]):
 231        risk_level = "critical"
 232    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["security", "vuln", "auth", "boundary", "migration", "k8s", "ingress", "infra"]):
 233        risk_level = "high"
 234    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["doc", "typo", "readme", "comment", "format", "style", "lint"]):
 235        risk_level = "low"
 236    else:
 237        risk_level = "medium"
 238
 239    if explicit_tier:
 240        reasoning_tier = explicit_tier
 241    elif risk_level in ("high", "critical") or task_class in ("security_patch", "infrastructure"):
 242        reasoning_tier = "tier_1"
 243    elif risk_level == "low" and task_class == "documentation":
 244        reasoning_tier = "tier_3"
 245    else:
 246        reasoning_tier = "tier_2"
 247
 248    return task_id, task_class, risk_level, reasoning_tier

 251def format_agent_launch_command(agent_id: str, spec: TaskSpec, run_dir: Path, target_repo: Path) -> str:
 252    """Generates the exact recommended agent launch command for the selected agent."""
 253    t_path = run_dir / "task.yaml"
 254    rel_p = str(t_path.relative_to(target_repo)) if t_path.is_relative_to(target_repo) else str(t_path)
 255
 256    if agent_id == "agy":
 257        return f'agy -p "Task: {spec.task_id} - {spec.objective}. Review task spec at {rel_p} and execute." --mode accept-edits'
 258    elif agent_id == "claude_code":
 259        return f'claude "Execute governed task {spec.task_id}: {spec.objective} using control plane spec at {rel_p}"'
 260    elif agent_id == "codex":
 261        return f'codex "Execute task {spec.task_id}: {spec.objective} per {rel_p}"'
 262    elif agent_id == "devin_cli":
 263        return f'devin run --task-file {rel_p}'
 264    elif agent_id == "local_ollama":
 265        return f'ollama run qwen2.5-coder:32b "Task {spec.task_id}: {spec.objective}"'
 266    return f'# Launch {agent_id} for task spec at {rel_p}'

 269def create_task_plan(
 270    ctx: ProjectContext,
 271    target_repo: Path,
 272    cp_root: Optional[Path],
 273    args: argparse.Namespace,
 274    resource_pool: Optional[ProviderPoolManager] = None,
 275) -> Tuple[TaskSpec, RoutingDecision]:
 276    """Helper that constructs and routes a TaskSpec from CLI arguments."""
 277    tid, tclass, risk, tier = infer_task_metadata(
 278        objective=args.objective,
 279        repo_name=ctx.name,
 280        explicit_id=getattr(args, "task_id", None),
 281        explicit_risk=getattr(args, "risk", None),
 282        explicit_tier=getattr(args, "tier", None),
 283        explicit_class=getattr(args, "task_class", None),
 284    )
 285    skills = list(dict.fromkeys(ctx.skills + (getattr(args, "skills", None) or ["software_development"])))
 286    meta = {"target_repo_path": str(target_repo)}
 287    if cp_root:
 288        meta["control_plane_path"] = str(cp_root)
 289
 290    spec = TaskSpec(
 291        task_id=tid,
 292        repository=ctx.name,
 293        objective=args.objective,
 294        acceptance_criteria=getattr(args, "criteria", None) or [f"Complete objective: {args.objective}", "Pass deterministic verification suite"],
 295        constraints=getattr(args, "constraints", None) or ["Adhere to project AGENTS.md and control plane policies"],
 296        task_class=tclass,
 297        risk_level=risk,
 298        required_skills=skills,
 299        recommended_reasoning_tier=tier,
 300        preferred_agent=getattr(args, "agent", None),
 301        metadata=meta,
 302    )
 303    decision = TaskRouter(resource_pool=resource_pool).route(spec)
 304    return spec, decision

 307def _print_failover_accounting(res: OrchestrationResult) -> None:
 308    """Explains multi-attempt implementation so exhaustion is never a mystery."""
 309    attempts = res.implementation_attempts or []
 310    summary = res.failover_summary or {}
 311    if len(attempts) <= 1 and res.final_state != "failed":
 312        print("")
 313        return
 314    print("")
 315    print("Implementation attempts:")
 316    for attempt in attempts:
 317        label = attempt.get("resource_id") or "unknown"
 318        outcome = (
 319            "SUCCESS" if attempt.get("success")
 320            else (attempt.get("failure_class") or "FAILED")
 321        )
 322        print(f"  {attempt.get('attempt')}. {label:<14} {outcome}")
 323    if not attempts:
 324        print("  (none recorded)")
 325    if summary:
 326        print("")
 327        print("Failover:")
 328        print(
 329            "  Attempts used:                "
 330            f"{summary.get('attempts_used')}/{summary.get('attempts_allowed')}"
 331        )
 332        remaining = summary.get("remaining_eligible") or []
 333        print(
 334            "  Remaining eligible resources: "
 335            f"{', '.join(remaining) if remaining else 'none'}"
 336        )
 337        print(f"  Termination reason:           {summary.get('termination_reason')}")
 338        excluded = summary.get("excluded") or {}
 339        if excluded:
 340            print("  Excluded resources:")
 341            for resource_id, reason in sorted(excluded.items()):
 342                print(f"    {resource_id:<14} {reason}")
 343    print("")

 346def _print_orchestration_summary(
 347    res: OrchestrationResult,
 348    ctx: ProjectContext,
 349    spec: TaskSpec,
 350    decision: RoutingDecision,
 351) -> None:
 352    """Renders the standard terminal output after governed task execution."""
 353    status_header = "COMPLETE" if res.final_state == "complete" else (
 354        "AWAITING HUMAN APPROVAL" if res.final_state == "awaiting_human" else "FAILED"
 355    )
 356    print("=" * 60)
 357    print(f"HOWLPLANE — GOVERNED TASK {status_header}")
 358    print("=" * 60)
 359    print(f"Task:              {spec.task_id}")
 360    print(f"Repository:        {ctx.name}")
 361    print(f"Risk:              {spec.risk_level.upper()}")
 362    print("")
 363    print("Project Context:")
 364    print("  ProjectAdapter:  OK")
 365    hf_status = res.howlframe_audit_status
 366    if not hf_status and getattr(res, "run_dir", None):
 367        audit_path = Path(res.run_dir) / "howlframe_audit.json"
 368        if audit_path.exists():
 369            try:
 370                audit_data = json.loads(audit_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 371                hf_status = audit_data.get("audit_status") or audit_data.get("status")
 372            except Exception:
 373                pass
 374
 375    if hf_status:
 376        hf_str = hf_status
 377    elif res.howlframe_audit_match is True:
 378        hf_str = "PASS / MATCH (shadow)"
 379    elif res.howlframe_audit_match is False:
 380        hf_str = "MISMATCH"
 381    else:
 382        hf_str = "NOT COMPUTED"
 383    print(f"  HowlFrame:       {hf_str}")
 384    print("")
 385    print("Routing:")
 386    final_impl_name = res.executing_provider or decision.selected_agent_name
 387    print(f"  Implementation:  {final_impl_name}")
 388    if res.executing_provider and res.executing_provider != decision.selected_agent_id:
 389        print(f"  Initial route:   {decision.selected_agent_name}")
 390    print(f"  Reasoning Tier:  {decision.reasoning_tier}")
 391    print("")
 392    print("Implementation:")
 393    delta = res.final_delta
 394    is_failed_impl = (
 395        res.final_state == "failed"
 396        and res.provider_execution is not None
 397        and not res.provider_execution.success
 398    )
 399    if is_failed_impl:
 400        print("  Status:                     FAILED")
 401        provider_name = res.executing_provider or decision.selected_agent_name
 402        print(f"  Provider:                   {provider_name}")
 403        has_partial = delta is not None and not delta.is_empty
 404        print(f"  Partial repository changes: {'YES' if has_partial else 'NO'}")
 405        fc = (len(delta.files_modified) + len(delta.files_added)) if has_partial else 0
 406        ins = delta.insertions if has_partial else 0
 407        dels = delta.deletions if has_partial else 0
 408        print(f"  Files Changed:              {fc}")
 409        print(f"  Insertions:                  {ins}")
 410        print(f"  Deletions:                  {dels}")
 411        if has_partial:
 412            print("  Changes reviewed:           NO")
 413            print("  Changes verified:           NO")
 414    else:
 415        fc = (len(delta.files_modified) + len(delta.files_added)) if delta else 0
 416        ins = delta.insertions if delta else 0
 417        dels = delta.deletions if delta else 0
 418        print(f"  Files Changed:   {fc}")
 419        print(f"  Insertions:       {ins}")
 420        print(f"  Deletions:       {dels}")
 421    _print_failover_accounting(res)
 422    print("Review:")
 423    if res.review_cycles:
 424        last_cycle = res.review_cycles[-1]
 425        non_independent = set(getattr(last_cycle, "non_independent_roles", []) or [])
 426        for role_id in decision.recommended_reviewers:
 427            role_res = last_cycle.reviewer_results.get(role_id)
 428            role_label = role_id.replace("-reviewer", "").capitalize()
 429            if role_res is None:
 430                status_text = "NOT RUN"
 431            elif role_res.status == "reviewer_failure":
 432                status_text = "FAILED (no verdict)"
 433            elif role_res.findings:
 434                sev_summary = f"{role_res.findings[0].severity.upper()}"
 435                status_text = f"{sev_summary} → REMEDIATED" if res.final_state == "complete" and res.remediation_cycles_count > 0 else f"{sev_summary} ({len(role_res.findings)} findings)"
 436            else:
 437                status_text = "PASS"
 438            if role_id in non_independent:
 439                status_text = f"{status_text} ⚠ SELF-REVIEW (implementer)"
 440            print(f"  {role_label:<17} {status_text}")
 441    else:
 442        print("  (No review cycles executed)")
 443    print("")
 444    print("Remediation:")
 445    print(f"  Cycles:           {res.remediation_cycles_count}")
 446    print("")
 447    print("Verification:")
 448    if res.verification_plan and res.verification_plan.steps:
 449        executed_steps = [
 450            s for s in res.verification_plan.steps
 451            if s.exit_code is not None or s.status in ("verified", "failed")
 452        ]
 453        if not executed_steps:
 454            total_steps = len(res.verification_plan.steps)
 455            print(f"  Discovered:      {total_steps} steps")
 456            print("  Executed:        0")
 457            if res.final_state == "failed":
 458                print("  Status:          NOT RUN — implementation failed before verification")
 459            else:
 460                print(f"  Status:          NOT RUN — task {res.final_state} before verification")
 461        else:
 462            for s in res.verification_plan.steps:
 463                status_tag = "VERIFIED" if s.status == "verified" else s.status.upper()
 464                print(f"  {s.name:<17} {status_tag}")
 465    else:
 466        print("  (No automated verification steps discovered)")
 467    print("")
 468    print("Human Authority:")
 469    req_human = (res.final_state == "awaiting_human") or bool(
 470        res.boundary_result and res.boundary_result.requires_human_approval
 471    )
 472    print(f"  Required:         {'Yes (🛑 Triggered)' if req_human else 'No'}")
 473    print("")
 474    print("Evidence:")
 475    print(f"  {res.run_dir}/")
 476    print("")
 477    final_verdict = (
 478        "VERIFIED COMPLETE" if res.final_state == "complete"
 479        else ("AWAITING HUMAN AUTHORIZATION" if res.final_state == "awaiting_human" else "FAILED")
 480    )
 481    print(f"Final State:\n  {final_verdict}")
 482    print("=" * 60)

 488def cmd_work(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
 489    """Executes the governed work command from any target repository."""
 490    target_repo = _resolve_repo(args)
 491    cp_root = find_control_plane_root(getattr(args, "control_plane_dir", None))
 492
 493    if not getattr(args, "skip_doctor", False):
 494        from howlplane.control_plane.doctor import check_dependencies, check_git_status
 495        dep_res = check_dependencies()
 496        if dep_res.status == "error" and not getattr(args, "force", False):
 497            print(f"ERROR: control-plane preflight failed: {dep_res.message}", file=sys.stderr)
 498            return 1
 499        git_res = check_git_status(target_repo)
 500        if git_res.status == "error" and not getattr(args, "force", False):
 501            print(f"ERROR: target repository preflight failed: {git_res.message}", file=sys.stderr)
 502            return 1
 503
 504    ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(target_repo)
 505    resource_pool = ProviderPoolManager.from_config()
 506    spec, decision = create_task_plan(
 507        ctx, target_repo, cp_root, args, resource_pool=resource_pool
 508    )
 509
 510    planned_actions = getattr(args, "actions", None) or []
 511    progress_mode = getattr(args, "progress", "auto")
 512    if getattr(args, "quiet", False):
 513        progress_mode = "never"
 514
 515    orchestrator = GovernedTaskOrchestrator(
 516        target_repo=target_repo,
 517        control_plane_root=cp_root,
 518        config=OrchestrationConfig(
 519            force=getattr(args, "force", False),
 520            skip_doctor=getattr(args, "skip_doctor", False),
 521            provider_pool=resource_pool,
 522            progress_mode=progress_mode,
 523        ),
 524    )
 525
 526    if getattr(args, "execute", False):
 527        res = orchestrator.run(spec, planned_actions=planned_actions)
 528        _print_orchestration_summary(res, ctx, spec, decision)
 529        return res.exit_code
 530
 531    # Dry run / task preparation mode (default when --execute is omitted)
 532    ctx, decision, plan, run_dir, shadow_audit_res = orchestrator.prepare_task_plan(spec, planned_actions)
 533    boundary_res = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate(spec, planned_actions=planned_actions, verification=plan)
 534    if not decision.selected_agent_id and not boundary_res.requires_human_approval:
 535        print(json.dumps(decision.metadata["blocked_outcome"], indent=2))
 536        return 3
 537    launch_cmd = format_agent_launch_command(decision.selected_agent_id, spec, run_dir, target_repo)
 538    df_mode = get_dogfood_mode()
 539
 540    print("=" * 60)
 541    print("AI ENGINEERING CONTROL PLANE — TASK INITIALIZED")
 542    print("=" * 60)
 543    print(f"Target Repository:    {target_repo} ({ctx.name})")
 544    print(f"Project Stack:        {', '.join(ctx.project_types) or 'generic'}")
 545    print(f"Project AGENTS.md:    {'Present' if ctx.has_agents_md else 'Not found (using global policy)'}")
 546    print(f"Hygiene Policy:       {ctx.hygiene_status}")
 547    print(f"Task ID:              {spec.task_id}")
 548    print(f"Objective:            {spec.objective}")
 549    print(f"Risk Level:           {spec.risk_level.upper()}")
 550    print(f"Reasoning Tier:       {decision.reasoning_tier}")
 551    if decision.is_override:
 552        print(f"Override Note:        {decision.override_reason}")
 553    if df_mode == "shadow" and shadow_audit_res:
 554        print("-" * 60)
 555        print("HOWLFRAME SHADOW AUDIT (DOGFOODING):")
 556        print(f"  Result:             {shadow_audit_res.audit_status or 'N/A'} ({shadow_audit_res.status}) [{shadow_audit_res.duration_seconds}s]")
 557        if shadow_audit_res.findings:
 558            print(f"  Findings:           {', '.join(shadow_audit_res.findings)}")
 559        if shadow_audit_res.comparison_notes:
 560            print(f"  Disagreements:      {', '.join(shadow_audit_res.comparison_notes)}")
 561    print("-" * 60)
 562    print("TASK ROUTING DECISION:")
 563    print(f"Selected Agent:       {decision.selected_agent_name} (`{decision.selected_agent_id}`)")
 564    print(f"Rationale:            {decision.rationale}")
 565    print(f"Reviewer Roles:       {', '.join(decision.recommended_reviewers)}")
 566    print("-" * 60)
 567    print("DETERMINISTIC VERIFICATION PLAN:")
 568    if plan.steps:
 569        for idx, s in enumerate(plan.steps, 1):
 570            print(f"  {idx}. [{s.category}] {s.name}")
 571    else:
 572        print("  (No automatic test/build steps discovered)")
 573    print("-" * 60)
 574    print("HUMAN AUTHORITY BOUNDARY:")
 575    if boundary_res.requires_human_approval:
 576        print("  🛑 AWAITING HUMAN APPROVAL (Boundary Triggered)")
 577        for b in boundary_res.triggered_boundaries:
 578            print(f"     - Boundary: {b}")
 579        if boundary_res.decision_packet:
 580            dp_path = run_dir / "decision_packet.md"
 581            dp_path.write_text(boundary_res.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
 582            print(f"     - Decision packet written to: {dp_path}")
 583    else:
 584        print("  ✓ All actions within Autonomous Operating Authority")
 585    print("-" * 60)
 586    print("RUN ARTIFACTS PREPARED:")
 587    print(f"Run Directory:        {run_dir}")
 588    print(f"- Task Spec:          {run_dir / 'task.yaml'}")
 589    print(f"- Review Briefs:      {run_dir / 'reviews'}/ ({len(decision.recommended_reviewers)} briefs)")
 590    print(f"- Findings Template:  {run_dir / 'findings_template.yaml'}")
 591    print(f"- Verification Plan:  {run_dir / 'verification_plan.json'}")
 592    print("-" * 60)
 593    print("RECOMMENDED AGENT LAUNCH COMMAND:")
 594    print(f"  {launch_cmd}")
 595    print("=" * 60)
 596
 597    return 2 if boundary_res.requires_human_approval else 0

 600def cmd_route(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
 601    """Lightweight read-only routing of an objective against the current target repository."""
 602    target_repo = _resolve_repo(args)
 603    ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(target_repo)
 604    pool = ProviderPoolManager.from_config(read_only=True, probe_on_start=False)
 605    spec, _decision = create_task_plan(
 606        ctx, target_repo, None, args, resource_pool=pool
 607    )
 608    selection = pool.select_resource(
 609        spec,
 610        role=getattr(args, "role", "implementation"),
 611        explicit_resource_id=getattr(args, "agent", None),
 612    )
 613    if getattr(args, "json", False):
 614        print(json.dumps(selection.to_dict(), indent=2))
 615    else:
 616        print(f"Target Repository: {target_repo} ({ctx.name})")
 617        print(f"Objective: {spec.objective}\n")
 618        print(render_route(selection))
 619    return 0 if selection.selected else 3

 622def cmd_providers(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
 623    """Shows inventory or resets exactly one current capacity record."""
 624    action = getattr(args, "provider_action", None)
 625    resource_id = getattr(args, "resource_id", None)
 626    if action == "reset":
 627        if not resource_id:
 628            print("ERROR: ai providers reset requires a resource ID", file=sys.stderr)
 629            return 1
 630        pool = ProviderPoolManager.from_config(probe_on_start=False)
 631        state = pool.reset_resource(resource_id, reprobe=True)
 632        try:
 633            import howlplane.control_plane.launcher as _launcher
 634            ledger_cls = getattr(_launcher, "EvidenceLedger", EvidenceLedger)
 635        except Exception:
 636            ledger_cls = EvidenceLedger
 637        ledger_cls().append_entry(EvidenceEntry(
 638            task_id="AI-RESOURCE-POOL",
 639            agent_id="operator",
 640            action="provider_capacity_reset",
 641            result="reset",
 642            metadata={
 643                "resource_id": resource_id,
 644                "capacity": state.status.value,
 645                "readiness": state.readiness.value,
 646            },
 647        ))
 648        print(json.dumps(state.to_dict(), indent=2) if getattr(args, "json", False) else (
 649            f"Reset {resource_id}: readiness={state.readiness.value}; "
 650            f"capacity={state.status.value}"
 651        ))
 652        return 0
 653    pool = ProviderPoolManager.from_config(read_only=True, probe_on_start=True)
 654    print(
 655        json.dumps(inventory_document(pool), indent=2)
 656        if getattr(args, "json", False) else render_inventory(pool)
 657    )
 658    return 0

 661def cmd_status(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
 662    """Displays project status, active task runs, lock status, and crash recovery diagnostics."""
 663    target_repo = _resolve_repo(args)
 664    cp_root = find_control_plane_root(getattr(args, "control_plane_dir", None))
 665    ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(target_repo)
 666
 667    print("=" * 60)
 668    print(f"AI CONTROL PLANE — PROJECT STATUS: {ctx.name}")
 669    print("=" * 60)
 670    print(f"Repository Path:    {target_repo}")
 671    print(f"Control Plane:      {cp_root}")
 672    print(f"Project Stack:      {', '.join(ctx.project_types) or 'generic'}")
 673    print(f"Project AGENTS.md:  {'Present' if ctx.has_agents_md else 'Not found'}")
 674    print(f"Hygiene Status:     {ctx.hygiene_status}")
 675
 676    # Inspect Repository Lock
 677    repo_lock_file = get_repo_lock_path(target_repo)
 678    if repo_lock_file.exists():
 679        try:
 680            l_data = json.loads(repo_lock_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 681            alive, _ = is_process_alive(l_data.get("pid", 0), l_data.get("hostname", ""))
 682            status_str = "ACTIVE" if alive else "STALE (Reclaimable)"
 683            print(f"Repository Lock:    {status_str} — Task: {l_data.get('task_id')}, PID: {l_data.get('pid')}, Command: '{l_data.get('command')}'")
 684        except Exception:
 685            print("Repository Lock:    Present (Unparseable)")
 686    else:
 687        print("Repository Lock:    Unlocked (Available)")
 688
 689    print("-" * 60)
 690    print("VERIFICATION COMMANDS DISCOVERED:")
 691    plan = ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(ctx, task_id="STATUS-CHECK")
 692    if plan.steps:
 693        for idx, s in enumerate(plan.steps, 1):
 694            cmd_display = ' '.join(s.command) if isinstance(s.command, list) else s.command
 695            print(f"  {idx}. [{s.category}] {cmd_display}")
 696    else:
 697        print("  (No automatic test/build commands detected)")
 698
 699    df_mode = get_dogfood_mode()
 700    h_bin = find_howlframe_binary()
 701    h_ver = get_howlframe_version(h_bin) if h_bin else None
 702    print("-" * 60)
 703    print("HOWLFRAME DOGFOOD STATUS:")
 704    print(f"  Mode:               {df_mode}")
 705    if h_bin:
 706        print(f"  Binary:             {h_bin} ({h_ver or '0.1.0'})")
 707        if df_mode == "shadow":
 708            audit_res = HowlFrameAuditRunner.run_audit(ctx, record_evidence=False, dogfood_mode="shadow")
 709            print(f"  Audit Result:       {audit_res.audit_status or 'N/A'} ({audit_res.status}) [{audit_res.duration_seconds}s]")
 710            if audit_res.findings:
 711                print(f"  Findings:           {', '.join(audit_res.findings)}")
 712            if audit_res.comparison_notes:
 713                print(f"  Disagreements:      {', '.join(audit_res.comparison_notes)}")
 714    else:
 715        print("  Binary:             Not available (PATH)")
 716
 717    task_runs_dir = target_repo / ".task_runs"
 718    runs = []
 719    if task_runs_dir.is_dir():
 720        runs = [d.name for d in task_runs_dir.iterdir() if d.is_dir() and (d / "task.yaml").exists()]
 721
 722    print("-" * 60)
 723    print(f"ACTIVE TASK RUNS ({len(runs)}):")
 724    if runs:
 725        for r in sorted(runs):
 726            t_dir = task_runs_dir / r
 727            t_file = t_dir / "task.yaml"
 728            try:
 729                rec_diag = CrashRecoveryEngine.inspect_task(target_repo, r)
 730                t_spec = TaskSpec.load_from_file(str(t_file))
 731                rec_file = t_dir / "reconciliation.json"
 732                blockers = 0
 733                highs = 0
 734                if rec_file.exists():
 735                    try:
 736                        rec_data = json.loads(rec_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 737                        blockers = rec_data.get("summary", {}).get("unresolved_blockers", 0)
 738                        highs = rec_data.get("summary", {}).get("unresolved_highs", 0)
 739                    except Exception:
 740                        pass
 741                ver_file = t_dir / "verification_result.json"
 742                ver_status = "unverified"
 743                if ver_file.exists():
 744                    try:
 745                        ver_data = json.loads(ver_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 746                        ver_status = ver_data.get("overall_status", "unverified")
 747                    except Exception:
 748                        pass
 749
 750                dp_file = t_dir / "decision_packet.md"
 751                dp_rel = (
 752                    str(dp_file.relative_to(target_repo))
 753                    if dp_file.is_file() and dp_file.is_relative_to(target_repo)
 754                    else str(dp_file)
 755                )
 756
 757                prog_file = t_dir / "progress.json"
 758                prog_data = None
 759                if prog_file.is_file():
 760                    try:
 761                        prog_data = safe_load_json(prog_file)
 762                    except Exception:
 763                        prog_data = None
 764
 765                if t_spec.current_state == "awaiting_human":
 766                    dec_record = HumanLifecycleManager.load_decision(t_dir)
 767                    current_fp = compute_repository_fingerprint(target_repo, t_dir)
 768                    boundaries_list = t_spec.human_approval_requirements or ["human_authority_boundary"]
 769                    boundaries_str = ", ".join(boundaries_list)
 770                    receipt_file = t_dir / "execution_receipt.json"
 771
 772                    print(f"  Task:               {t_spec.task_id}")
 773                    print(f"  State:              AWAITING_HUMAN (Stage: {rec_diag.get('last_stage', 'awaiting_human')})")
 774                    print(f"  Verification:       {ver_status.upper()}")
 775                    if dec_record and dec_record.changeops_decision_id:
 776                        print(f"  ChangeOps Decision: {dec_record.changeops_decision_id}")
 777                    if receipt_file.is_file():
 778                        try:
 779                            rc_data = json.loads(receipt_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 780                            print(f"  Execution Receipt:  {rc_data.get('status', 'unknown').upper()} (Verification: {rc_data.get('verification_status', 'PASS')})")
 781                        except Exception:
 782                            pass
 783                    elif rec_diag.get("native_receipt_found"):
 784                        print("  Execution Receipt:  PENDING_RECONCILIATION (Found in HowlChangeOps native receipts)")
 785
 786                    if not dec_record:
 787                        print(f"  Repository State:   CURRENT")
 788                        print(f"  Boundary:           {boundaries_str}")
 789                        print(f"  Decision:           pending")
 790                        if dp_file.is_file():
 791                            print(f"  Decision Packet:    {dp_rel}")
 792                        print("")
 793                        print("  Next Action:")
 794                        print(f"    howlplane approve {t_spec.task_id}")
 795                        print(f"    howlplane reject {t_spec.task_id}")
 796                    elif dec_record.decision == "approved":
 797                        has_drift, drift_reason = (
 798                            check_repository_drift(dec_record.repository_state, current_fp)
 799                            if dec_record.repository_state
 800                            else (False, None)
 801                        )
 802                        appr_state = f"STALE ({drift_reason})" if has_drift else "CURRENT"
 803                        print(f"  Boundary:           {boundaries_str}")
 804                        print(f"  Decision:           APPROVED")
 805                        print(f"  Approval State:     {appr_state}")
 806                        if dp_file.is_file():
 807                            print(f"  Decision Packet:    {dp_rel}")
 808                        print("")
 809                        print("  Next Action:")
 810                        if has_drift:
 811                            print(f"    howlplane approve {t_spec.task_id} --reason \"re-approved after drift\"")
 812                        else:
 813                            print(f"    howlplane resume {t_spec.task_id}")
 814                    elif dec_record.decision == "rejected":
 815                        print(f"  Decision:           REJECTED")
 816                        if dec_record.reason:
 817                            print(f"  Reason:             {dec_record.reason}")
 818                        print("  Terminal state:     FAILED (Rejected)")
 819                    print("-" * 40)
 820                elif (
 821                    prog_data
 822                    and prog_data.get("state") == "RUNNING"
 823                    and t_spec.current_state not in TERMINAL_TASK_STATES
 824                ):
 825                    p_phase = prog_data.get("phase", t_spec.current_state.upper())
 826                    p_resource = prog_data.get("resource_id") or t_spec.actual_agent or t_spec.recommended_agent or "N/A"
 827                    p_elapsed = format_elapsed(prog_data.get("elapsed_seconds", 0))
 828                    p_heartbeat = format_last_heartbeat(prog_data.get("updated_at"))
 829                    p_pid = prog_data.get("pid")
 830
 831                    is_proc_alive = False
 832                    if rec_diag.get("is_process_running"):
 833                        is_proc_alive = True
 834                    elif p_pid:
 835                        import socket
 836                        from howlplane.control_plane.locking import is_process_alive as check_pid_alive
 837                        is_proc_alive, _ = check_pid_alive(p_pid, socket.gethostname())
 838
 839                    state_label = "RUNNING" if is_proc_alive else "STALE (Process not running)"
 840
 841                    print(f"  {t_spec.task_id}")
 842                    print(f"    State:          {state_label}")
 843                    print(f"    Phase:          {p_phase}")
 844                    print(f"    Resource:       {p_resource}")
 845                    print(f"    Elapsed:        {p_elapsed}")
 846                    print(f"    Last heartbeat: {p_heartbeat}")
 847                    c_revs = rec_diag.get("completed_reviewers", [])
 848                    if c_revs:
 849                        print(f"    Completed Reviews: {', '.join(c_revs)}")
 850                    for role, disposition in (rec_diag.get("reviewer_dispositions") or {}).items():
 851                        if disposition not in ("completed_clean", "completed_with_findings"):
 852                            print(f"      - {role}: {disposition.upper()}")
 853                    if not is_proc_alive:
 854                        rec_action = rec_diag.get('recommendation') or f"howlplane resume {t_spec.task_id}"
 855                        print(f"    Recommendation:    {rec_action}")
 856                    print("-" * 40)
 857                elif t_spec.current_state in ("interrupted", "cancelled", "implementing", "reviewing", "remediating", "verifying"):
 858                    print(f"  Task:               {t_spec.task_id}")
 859                    print(f"  State:              {t_spec.current_state.upper()} (Last Stage: {rec_diag.get('last_stage')})")
 860                    print(f"  Classification:     {rec_diag.get('classification', 'RECONCILE_FIRST')}")
 861                    if rec_diag.get("is_process_running"):
 862                        p_info = rec_diag.get("process_info") or {}
 863                        print(f"  Process:            RUNNING (PID: {p_info.get('pid')}, Backend: {p_info.get('backend')})")
 864                    if rec_diag.get("completed_reviewers"):
 865                        print(f"  Completed Reviews:  {', '.join(rec_diag.get('completed_reviewers'))}")
 866                    if rec_diag.get("incomplete_reviewers"):
 867                        print(f"  Pending Reviews:    {', '.join(rec_diag.get('incomplete_reviewers'))}")
 868                    for role, disposition in (rec_diag.get("reviewer_dispositions") or {}).items():
 869                        if disposition not in ("completed_clean", "completed_with_findings"):
 870                            print(f"    - {role}: {disposition.upper()}")
 871                    print(f"  Recommendation:     {rec_diag.get('recommendation')}")
 872                    print("-" * 40)
 873                else:
 874                    print(f"  - {r}: [{t_spec.current_state.upper()}] {t_spec.objective} (Risk: {t_spec.risk_level.upper()}, Agent: {t_spec.actual_agent or t_spec.recommended_agent or 'N/A'}, Blockers: {blockers}, Highs: {highs}, Verification: {ver_status})")
 875            except Exception:
 876                print(f"  - {r}")
 877    else:
 878        print("  (No task runs in .task_runs/)")
 879
 880    journal_dir = target_repo / "documentation" / "task_journals"
 881    journals = []
 882    if journal_dir.is_dir():
 883        journals = [f.name for f in journal_dir.glob("*.md") if f.name != "TEMPLATE.md"]
 884
 885    if journals:
 886        print("-" * 60)
 887        print(f"TASK JOURNALS ({len(journals)}):")
 888        for j in sorted(journals):
 889            print(f"  - {j}")
 890
 891    print("=" * 60)
 892    return 0

 895def cmd_init_task(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
 896    """Creates a new TaskSpec file."""
 897    spec = TaskSpec(
 898        task_id=args.task_id,
 899        repository=args.repo,
 900        objective=args.objective,
 901        acceptance_criteria=args.criteria or [],
 902        constraints=args.constraints or [],
 903        task_class=args.task_class or "feature",
 904        risk_level=args.risk,
 905        required_skills=args.skills or [],
 906        recommended_reasoning_tier=args.tier,
 907        preferred_agent=args.preferred_agent,
 908    )
 909    out_path = args.output or f"task_{spec.task_id}.yaml"
 910    spec.save_to_file(out_path)
 911    print(f"Task specification written to: {out_path}")
 912    return 0

 924def cmd_briefs(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
 925    """Generates independent review briefs for a task diff."""
 926    spec = TaskSpec.load_from_file(args.task_file)
 927    diff_text = Path(args.diff_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8") if args.diff_file else ""
 928
 929    router = TaskRouter()
 930    decision = router.route(spec)
 931    reviewers_to_run = args.roles or decision.recommended_reviewers
 932
 933    out_dir = Path(args.output_dir or "review_briefs")
 934    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 935
 936    print(f"Generating review briefs for {len(reviewers_to_run)} roles in {out_dir}/...")
 937    for role_id in reviewers_to_run:
 938        role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
 939        if not role:
 940            print(f"Warning: Unknown reviewer role '{role_id}', skipping.")
 941            continue
 942        brief = role.render_brief(task=spec, diff_content=diff_text)
 943        brief_file = out_dir / f"brief_{role_id}.md"
 944        brief_file.write_text(brief, encoding="utf-8")
 945        print(f" - Wrote: {brief_file}")
 946    return 0

 949def cmd_prepare_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
 950    """Prepares structured task run directory and reviewer briefs for cross-agent handoffs."""
 951    spec = TaskSpec.load_from_file(args.task_file)
 952    diff_text = Path(args.diff_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8") if args.diff_file else ""
 953
 954    run_dir = Path(args.run_dir or f".task_runs/{spec.task_id}")
 955    reviews_dir = run_dir / "reviews"
 956    reviews_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 957
 958    # Save copy of task spec and diff
 959    spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 960    if diff_text:
 961        (run_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(diff_text, encoding="utf-8")
 962
 963    router = TaskRouter()
 964    decision = router.route(spec)
 965    reviewers_to_run = args.roles or decision.recommended_reviewers
 966
 967    print(f"Preparing dogfood task run in {run_dir}/...")
 968    print(f"- Implementation Agent: {decision.selected_agent_name} (`{decision.selected_agent_id}`)")
 969    print(f"- Generating {len(reviewers_to_run)} independent reviewer briefs in {reviews_dir}/:")
 970
 971    for role_id in reviewers_to_run:
 972        role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
 973        if not role:
 974            continue
 975        brief = role.render_brief(task=spec, diff_content=diff_text)
 976        brief_file = reviews_dir / f"{role_id}.md"
 977        brief_file.write_text(brief, encoding="utf-8")
 978        print(f"   ✓ {brief_file.name}")
 979
 980    # Write findings template
 981    template_file = run_dir / "findings_template.yaml"
 982    template_content = """# Review Findings Template
 983# Collect structured findings from independent reviewer roles below.
 984findings:
 985  # Example:
 986  # - id: "F001"
 987  #   reviewer_role: "test-falsifier"
 988  #   title: "Missing negative test case for edge input"
 989  #   severity: "high"
 990  #   category: "test_gap"
 991  #   location: "tests/test_feature.py:45"
 992  #   description: "Test does not check None input handling."
 993  #   evidence: "Calling feature(None) raises unhandled exception."
 994  #   suggested_fix: "Add test_feature_handles_none_gracefully."
 995"""
 996    template_file.write_text(template_content, encoding="utf-8")
 997    print(f"- Template written: {template_file}")
 998    print(f"\nTask run initialized successfully at {run_dir}.")
 999    return 0

1027def cmd_verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
1028    """Executes a verification plan for a project or task."""
1029    target_repo = _resolve_repo(args)
1030    context = ProjectAdapter.discover(target_repo)
1031    task_id = getattr(args, "task_id", None) or "VERIFY-RUN"
1032
1033    plan = ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(context, task_id=task_id)
1034    print(f"Running verification plan for project '{context.name}' ({len(plan.steps)} steps)...")
1035    status = plan.execute_all(cwd=str(target_repo))
1036
1037    for step in plan.steps:
1038        mark = "✓" if step.status == "verified" else "✗"
1039        interp_info = f" [using {step.interpreter}]" if step.interpreter else ""
1040        print(f"[{mark}] {step.name}: {step.status} (exit {step.exit_code}, {step.duration_seconds}s){interp_info}")
1041        if step.status == "failed" and step.stderr:
1042            print(f"    Error: {step.stderr.strip()[:200]}")
1043
1044    print(f"\nOverall Verification Status: {status.upper()}")
1045
1046    out_file = args.output
1047    if not out_file and args.run_dir:
1048        out_file = str(Path(args.run_dir) / "verification.json")
1049
1050    if out_file:
1051        Path(out_file).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
1052        Path(out_file).write_text(plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
1053        print(f"Saved verification output to {out_file}")
1054
1055    return 0 if status == "passed" else 1

1284def cmd_trace(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
1285    """Traces descent lineage DAG for an exploration run or candidate."""
1286    import json
1287    repo_dir = Path(getattr(args, "repo_dir", None) or ".").resolve()
1288    trace_id = args.trace_id
1289
1290    try:
1291        has_howldream = False
1292        try:
1293            from howldream.contracts import DescentDAG
1294
1295            has_howldream = True
1296        except ImportError:
1297            DescentDAG = None
1298
1299        found_chain = None
1300        for envelope_path in repo_dir.glob("**/exploration_envelope.json"):
1301            if envelope_path.is_file():
1302                with open(envelope_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
1303                    env_data = json.load(f)
1304                dag_data = env_data.get("descent_dag") or env_data.get("lineage_dag")
1305                if not dag_data:
1306                    continue
1307
1308                if has_howldream and DescentDAG is not None:
1309                    dag = DescentDAG.model_validate(dag_data)
1310                    if trace_id in dag.nodes:
1311                        chain = dag.trace(trace_id)
1312                        found_chain = [node.model_dump() for node in chain]
1313                        break
1314                else:
1315                    nodes = dag_data.get("nodes", {})
1316                    if isinstance(nodes, list):
1317                        nodes = {n.get("node_id"): n for n in nodes if isinstance(n, dict)}
1318                    if trace_id in nodes:
1319                        edges = dag_data.get("edges", [])
1320                        visited = set()
1321                        chain = []
1322
1323                        def _walk(curr: str):
1324                            if curr in visited or curr not in nodes:
1325                                return
1326                            visited.add(curr)
1327                            chain.append(nodes[curr])
1328                            for edge in edges:
1329                                if isinstance(edge, dict) and edge.get("target") == curr:
1330                                    src = edge.get("source")
1331                                    if src:
1332                                        _walk(src)
1333
1334                        _walk(trace_id)
1335                        found_chain = chain
1336                        break
1337
1338        if found_chain is not None:
1339            if getattr(args, "json", False):
1340                print(json.dumps(found_chain, indent=2))
1341            else:
1342                print(f"Lineage trace for '{trace_id}' ({len(found_chain)} nodes):")
1343                for node in found_chain:
1344                    node_type = node.get("node_type", "unknown")
1345                    node_id = node.get("node_id", "")
1346                    label = node.get("label", "")
1347                    print(f"  - [{node_type}] {node_id}: {label}")
1348            return 0
1349        else:
1350            print(f"Node or candidate '{trace_id}' not found in lineage DAGs.")
1351            return 1
1352    except Exception as exc:
1353        print(f"Error tracing '{trace_id}': {exc}")
1354        return 1
1355

1357def build_parser(program_name: str = "howlplane") -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
1358    common_parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
1359    common_parser.add_argument(
1360        "--control-plane-dir",
1361        "-C",
1362        help="Explicit path to HowlPlane control plane repository",
1363    )
1364    common_parser.add_argument(
1365        "--repo",
1366        "-R",
1367        help="Target Git repository directory (defaults to current working directory discovery)",
1368    )
1369
1370    task_base_parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
1371    task_base_parser.add_argument("objective", help="Task objective or description")
1372    task_base_parser.add_argument("--task-id", help="Explicit task ID")
1373    task_base_parser.add_argument("--risk", choices=["low", "medium", "high", "critical"], help="Risk level override")
1374    task_base_parser.add_argument("--tier", choices=["tier_1", "tier_2", "tier_3"], help="Reasoning tier override")
1375    task_base_parser.add_argument("--agent", help="Preferred agent override")
1376
1377    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
1378        prog=program_name,
1379        description="Deterministic Multi-Agent Engineering Control Plane CLI",
1380        parents=[common_parser],
1381    )
1382    parser.add_argument(
1383        "--version",
1384        action="version",
1385        version=f"{program_name} {__version__}",
1386    )
1387
1388    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="subcommand", help="Command to execute")
1389
1390    from howlplane.control_plane.orchestration import add_parser as add_orchestration_parser
1391    add_orchestration_parser(subparsers, common_parser)
1392
1393    # work
1394    p_work = subparsers.add_parser(
1395        "work",
1396        parents=[common_parser, task_base_parser],
1397        help="Run governed control-plane workflow on current repository",
1398    )
1399    p_work.add_argument("--task-class", help="Task class")
1400    p_work.add_argument("--criteria", nargs="*", help="Acceptance criteria list")
1401    p_work.add_argument("--constraints", nargs="*", help="Constraints list")
1402    p_work.add_argument("--actions", nargs="*", help="Planned actions for authority boundary checks")
1403    p_work.add_argument("--execute", "-x", action="store_true", help="Launch recommended agent CLI and execute closed loop")
1404    p_work.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Generate plan without launching")
1405    p_work.add_argument("--skip-doctor", action="store_true", help="Skip preflight diagnostics")
1406    p_work.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="Proceed even if preflight has warnings")
1407    p_work.add_argument(
1408        "--progress",
1409        choices=["auto", "always", "never"],
1410        default="auto",
1411        help="Operator progress output mode (auto, always, never)",
1412    )
1413    p_work.add_argument(
1414        "--quiet",
1415        "-q",
1416        action="store_true",
1417        help="Suppress operator progress output",
1418    )
1419
1420    # route
1421    p_route = subparsers.add_parser(
1422        "route",
1423        parents=[common_parser, task_base_parser],
1424        help="Route an objective against the current repository",
1425    )
1426    p_route.add_argument(
1427        "--role",
1428        choices=["planning", "implementation", "remediation", "review"],
1429        default="implementation",
1430    )
1431    p_route.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output JSON decision")
1432
1433    # providers
1434    p_providers = subparsers.add_parser(
1435        "providers", parents=[common_parser], help="Show the configured AI resource pool"
1436    )
1437    p_providers.add_argument("provider_action", nargs="?", choices=["reset"])
1438    p_providers.add_argument("resource_id", nargs="?")
1439    p_providers.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output versioned JSON")
1440
1441    # doctor
1442    subparsers.add_parser("doctor", parents=[common_parser], help="Run deterministic workspace health diagnostics")
1443
1444    # agents
1445    p_agents = subparsers.add_parser("agents", parents=[common_parser], help="Inspect supported agent CLIs")
1446    agents_sub = p_agents.add_subparsers(dest="agents_action")
1447    p_agents_doctor = agents_sub.add_parser(
1448        "doctor", help="Verify each agent CLI's readiness, unattended execution, models, and capacity visibility"
1449    )
1450    _add_readiness_arguments(p_agents_doctor)
1451    p_agents_doctor.add_argument("--agent", action="append", choices=list(agent_readiness.AGENT_ORDER),
1452                                 help="Limit to one agent (repeatable)")
1453    p_agents_doctor.add_argument("--refresh", action="store_true", help="Ignore cached evidence and probe again")
1454    p_agents_doctor.add_argument("--smoke-timeout", type=int, default=agent_readiness.DEFAULT_SMOKE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
1455                                 metavar="SECONDS", help="Per-agent limit for the --live smoke (default: 60)")
1456    p_agents_doctor.add_argument("--repo", metavar="PATH",
1457                                 help="Also report workspace readiness (trust) for this directory; "
1458                                      "with --live the read-only smoke runs there")
1459    _add_workspace_trust_argument(p_agents_doctor)
1460
1461    # status
1462    subparsers.add_parser("status", parents=[common_parser], help="Show project status and verification plan")
1463
1464    # init-task
1465    p_init = subparsers.add_parser("init-task", parents=[common_parser], help="Initialize a new task specification")
1466    p_init.add_argument("--task-id", required=True, help="Task ID (e.g. TASK-101)")
1467    p_init.add_argument("--objective", required=True, help="Task objective description")
1468    p_init.add_argument("--criteria", nargs="*", help="Acceptance criteria")
1469    p_init.add_argument("--constraints", nargs="*", help="Constraints")
1470    p_init.add_argument("--task-class", default="feature", help="Task class / category")
1471    p_init.add_argument("--risk", default="medium", choices=["low", "medium", "high", "critical"])
1472    p_init.add_argument("--skills", nargs="*", help="Required skills")
1473    p_init.add_argument("--tier", default="tier_2", choices=["tier_1", "tier_2", "tier_3"])
1474    p_init.add_argument("--preferred-agent", help="Preferred agent ID override")
1475    p_init.add_argument("--output", "-o", help="Output file path (YAML or JSON)")
1476
1477    # route-task
1478    p_route_task = subparsers.add_parser("route-task", parents=[common_parser], help="Route task to appropriate agent and reviewers")
1479    p_route_task.add_argument("--task-file", required=True, help="Path to task spec file")
1480
1481    # briefs
1482    p_briefs = subparsers.add_parser("briefs", parents=[common_parser], help="Generate independent reviewer briefs")
1483    p_briefs.add_argument("--task-file", required=True, help="Path to task spec file")
1484    p_briefs.add_argument("--diff-file", help="Path to diff file")
1485    p_briefs.add_argument("--roles", nargs="*", help="Specific reviewer roles to generate")
1486    p_briefs.add_argument("--output-dir", help="Output directory for briefs")
1487
1488    # prepare-run
1489    p_prep = subparsers.add_parser("prepare-run", parents=[common_parser], help="Prepare cross-agent dogfood task run artifacts")
1490    p_prep.add_argument("--task-file", required=True, help="Path to task spec file")
1491    p_prep.add_argument("--diff-file", help="Path to diff file")
1492    p_prep.add_argument("--roles", nargs="*", help="Specific reviewer roles to generate")
1493    p_prep.add_argument("--run-dir", help="Task run directory path")
1494
1495    # reconcile
1496    p_rec = subparsers.add_parser("reconcile", parents=[common_parser], help="Reconcile multi-agent review findings")

1572
1573    # resume

1575    p_res.add_argument("task_id", help="Task ID to resume")
1576    p_res.add_argument("--ledger-file", help="Ledger file path")

1579    # cancel

1581    p_can.add_argument("task_id", help="Task ID to cancel")
1582    p_can.add_argument("--reason", help="Optional reason for cancellation")
1583    p_can.add_argument("--ledger-file", help="Ledger file path")
1584    p_can.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output JSON result")
1585
1586    # unlock
1587    p_unlock = subparsers.add_parser(
1588        "unlock",

1591    )

1593    p_unlock.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output JSON result")
1594
1595    register_exploration_subparsers(subparsers, parents=[common_parser])
1596    register_factory_subparsers(subparsers, parents=[common_parser])
1597    register_synthesis_subparsers(subparsers, parents=[common_parser])
1598
1599    return parser

1807def register_synthesis_subparsers(subparsers: Any, parents: Optional[List[Any]] = None) -> None:
1808    kwargs = {"parents": parents} if parents else {}
1809    # create (Prompt-to-Product Synthesis)
1810    p_create = subparsers.add_parser("create", help="Create a runnable software product from natural language", **kwargs)
1811    p_create.add_argument("prompt", help="Natural language description of desired software outcome")
1812    p_create.add_argument("--output-dir", "-o", help="Target output product directory")
1813    p_create.add_argument("--avoid-provider", help="Avoid using specified provider if alternatives exist")
1814    p_create.add_argument("--agent", help="Preferred agent override")
1815    p_create.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8088, help="Default HTTP server port")
1816    p_create.add_argument("--ledger-file", help="Ledger file path")
1817    p_create.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output JSON result")
1818
1819    # run (Run verified product bundle)
1820    p_run = subparsers.add_parser("run", help="Run a verified product bundle", **kwargs)
1821    p_run.add_argument("product_dir", help="Path to product bundle directory")
1822    p_run.add_argument("--port", type=int, help="Override HTTP server port")
1823
1824    # dogfood (Marathon dogfooding loop)
1825    p_dogfood = subparsers.add_parser("dogfood", help="Run automated marathon dogfooding benchmarks", **kwargs)
1826    p_dogfood.add_argument("--benchmarks", help="Comma-separated list of benchmarks to run (notes,todo,status_api,inventory,json_transform)")
1827    p_dogfood.add_argument("--max-iterations", type=int, default=5, help="Maximum benchmark iterations")
1828    p_dogfood.add_argument("--until-providers-exhausted", action="store_true", help="Run until all external providers are exhausted")
1829    p_dogfood.add_argument("--avoid-provider", help="Avoid using specified provider if alternatives exist")
1830    p_dogfood.add_argument("--resume", help="Resume an existing dogfood campaign by campaign ID, preserving its persisted benchmark scope")
1831    p_dogfood.add_argument(
1832        "--status", metavar="CAMPAIGN_ID",
1833        help="Read-only: report a campaign's durable state and exit. Never invokes a provider, "
1834             "never synthesizes products, never changes campaign scope, consumes zero quota.",
1835    )
1836    p_dogfood.add_argument("--campaign-dir", default=".dogfood_runs", help="Base directory for durable campaign state")
1837    p_dogfood.add_argument("--output-dir", default="output", help="Base output directory for generated products")
1838    p_dogfood.add_argument("--ledger-file", help="Ledger file path")
1839    p_dogfood.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output JSON result")
1840    p_dogfood.add_argument(
1841        "--authority-profile", choices=["strict", "overnight-safe"], default=None,
1842        help=(
1843            "Binds delegated campaign authority for real git/GitHub integration (#59). "
1844            "Required for any autonomous merge; without it, the campaign proposes and "
1845            "implements but parks anything requiring authority. Selecting a profile is "
1846            "explicit operator authorization for exactly the actions it encodes -- the "
1847            "campaign cannot select or expand its own profile. On --resume, an unexpired "
1848            "existing envelope is reused automatically; passing this flag again on resume "
1849            "creates a fresh explicit reauthorization (required once the prior one expires)."
1850        ),
1851    )
1852    p_dogfood.add_argument("--target-repo", default=".", help="Repository root for real git/GitHub integration")
1853    p_dogfood.add_argument("--repo-slug", help="owner/repo for GitHub integration (auto-detected from origin remote if omitted)")
1854
1855    # acceptance (live governed-integration acceptance canary, #59.2 Phases 15-18)
1856    p_accept = subparsers.add_parser("acceptance", help="Live autonomous acceptance canary", **kwargs)
1857    accept_sub = p_accept.add_subparsers(dest="acceptance_action", required=True)
1858    p_overnight = accept_sub.add_parser(
1859        "overnight-integration",
1860        help="Run the one-shot live governed branch/commit/PR/CI/merge lifecycle canary",
1861    )
1862    p_overnight.add_argument(
1863        "--authority-profile", choices=["strict", "overnight-safe"], required=True,
1864        help="Delegated campaign authority the canary runs under. Required -- there is no "
1865             "default; an operator must explicitly authorize exactly the actions it encodes.",
1866    )
1867    p_overnight.add_argument("--target-repo", default=".", help="Repository root for real git/GitHub integration")
1868    p_overnight.add_argument("--repo-slug", help="owner/repo (auto-detected from origin remote if omitted)")
1869    p_overnight.add_argument("--campaign-dir", default=".dogfood_runs", help="Base directory for durable campaign state")
1870    p_overnight.add_argument("--ledger-file", help="Ledger file path")
1871    p_overnight.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output JSON result")
1872
1873    # marathon (bounded backlog-driven engineering marathon)
1874    p_marathon = subparsers.add_parser(
1875        "marathon", help="Work a bounded sequence of a repository's ranked backlog", **kwargs
1876    )
1877    p_marathon.add_argument(
1878        "--authority-profile", required=True,
1879        choices=["strict", "overnight-safe", "howlframe-overnight"],
1880        help="Delegated campaign authority. Required -- there is no default; an "
1881             "operator must explicitly authorize exactly the actions it encodes.",
1882    )
1883    p_marathon.add_argument("--target-repo", default=".", help="Repository whose backlog is worked")
1884    p_marathon.add_argument("--repo-slug", help="owner/repo (auto-detected from origin remote if omitted)")
1885    p_marathon.add_argument("--max-tasks", type=int, default=3, help="Maximum backlog items to attempt")
1886    p_marathon.add_argument("--max-runtime-hours", type=float, default=8.0, help="Wall-clock ceiling")
1887    p_marathon.add_argument("--roi-floor", type=float, default=0.5, help="Minimum backlog score to work")
1888    p_marathon.add_argument("--campaign-dir", default=".dogfood_runs", help="Durable campaign state directory")
1889    p_marathon.add_argument("--resume", help="Resume an existing campaign by id")
1890    p_marathon.add_argument("--ledger-file", help="Ledger file path")
1891    p_marathon.add_argument(
1892        "--dry-run", action="store_true",
1893        help="Show what would be worked and stop. Invokes no provider and writes nothing.",
1894    )
1895    p_marathon.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output JSON result")
1896
1897    # authority (read-only authority profile inspection, #59 Phase 26)
1898    #
1899    # The choices come from the canonical registry rather than a second
1900    # hard-coded list. The duplicate went stale the moment a third profile was
1901    # added: `howlframe-overnight` was a valid marathon authority profile that
1902    # could not be inspected, which is the wrong way round -- inspection is
1903    # read-only and is exactly what an operator does *before* granting it.
1904    # This does not widen any grant; `--authority-profile` choices on dogfood
1905    # and acceptance are deliberately left alone.
1906    from howlplane.control_plane.authority_profile import CANONICAL_PROFILES
1907
1908    p_authority = subparsers.add_parser("authority", help="Inspect delegated authority profiles (read-only)", **kwargs)
1909    authority_sub = p_authority.add_subparsers(dest="authority_action", required=True)
1910    p_authority_show = authority_sub.add_parser("show", help="Show a canonical authority profile's exact permissions")
1911    p_authority_show.add_argument("profile_id", choices=sorted(CANONICAL_PROFILES))
1912    p_authority_show.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output JSON result")
1913
1914    # local (local Ollama model setup/health check, #58 Phase 3)
1915    p_local = subparsers.add_parser("local", help="Local (Ollama) model utilities", **kwargs)
1916    p_local.add_argument("local_action", choices=["setup"], help="Action to perform")
1917    p_local.add_argument("--model", default="qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct", help="Model to pull/verify")
1918    p_local.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output JSON result")
1919

1921def cmd_marathon(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
1922    """Works a bounded sequence of the target repository's ranked backlog."""
1923    import json as _json
1924    import sys as _sys
1925    from howlplane.control_plane.backlog_source import BacklogSource
1926    from howlplane.control_plane.synthesis import MarathonDogfoodEngine
1927    from howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool import ProviderPoolManager
1928
1929    target_repo = getattr(args, "target_repo", None) or "."
1930
1931    if getattr(args, "dry_run", False):
1932        # Read-only: shows exactly which items are eligible and why the
1933        # near-misses are not, without binding an authority envelope or
1934        # invoking any provider.
1935        selection = BacklogSource(
1936            target_repo, roi_floor=getattr(args, "roi_floor", 0.5)
1937        ).select()
1938        payload = {
1939            "target_repo": target_repo,
1940            "files_read": selection.files_read,
1941            "eligible": [item.to_dict() for item in selection.eligible],
1942            "excluded": selection.excluded,
1943            "would_work": [
1944                item.task_id for item in selection.eligible[: args.max_tasks]
1945            ],
1946        }
1947        if getattr(args, "json", False):
1948            print(_json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
1949        else:
1950            print("=" * 60)
1951            print(f"HOWLPLANE — MARATHON DRY RUN: {target_repo}")
1952            print("=" * 60)
1953            print(f"Backlogs read:      {', '.join(selection.files_read) or 'none'}")
1954            print(f"Eligible items:     {len(selection.eligible)}")
1955            print(f"Would work (max {args.max_tasks}):")
1956            for item in selection.eligible[: args.max_tasks]:
1957                print(f"  - {item.task_id}  score={item.score}  {item.title}")
1958            if selection.excluded:
1959                print("\nPending but NOT eligible:")
1960                for excluded in selection.excluded:
1961                    print(f"  - #{excluded['item_id']} ({excluded['source_file']}): {excluded['reason']}")
1962            print("\nNo provider was invoked and nothing was written.")
1963        return 0
1964
1965    ledger = EvidenceLedger(args.ledger_file) if getattr(args, "ledger_file", None) else None
1966    engine = MarathonDogfoodEngine(
1967        provider_pool=ProviderPoolManager.from_config(),
1968        ledger=ledger,
1969        campaign_dir=getattr(args, "campaign_dir", None),
1970        target_repo=target_repo,
1971        repo_slug=getattr(args, "repo_slug", None),
1972    )
1973    report = engine.run_backlog_marathon(
1974        authority_profile_id=args.authority_profile,
1975        max_tasks=args.max_tasks,
1976        max_runtime_hours=args.max_runtime_hours,
1977        resume_campaign_id=getattr(args, "resume", None),
1978        roi_floor=getattr(args, "roi_floor", 0.5),
1979    )
1980
1981    if report.get("refused"):
1982        # Fail-closed preflight: the campaign never started. Reported on stderr
1983        # with a non-zero exit so an unattended wrapper cannot read it as a run
1984        # that simply found nothing to do.
1985        if getattr(args, "json", False):
1986            print(_json.dumps(report, indent=2))
1987        else:
1988            print("=" * 60, file=_sys.stderr)
1989            print("HOWLPLANE — MARATHON REFUSED", file=_sys.stderr)
1990            print("=" * 60, file=_sys.stderr)
1991            print(report["refusal_reason"], file=_sys.stderr)
1992            print("\nWorking tree changes found:", file=_sys.stderr)
1993            for path in report["dirty_files"]:
1994                print(f"  {path}", file=_sys.stderr)
1995        return 2
1996
1997    if getattr(args, "json", False):
1998        print(_json.dumps(report, indent=2))
1999    else:
2000        print("=" * 60)
2001        print(f"HOWLPLANE — BACKLOG MARATHON: {report['campaign_id']}")
2002        print("=" * 60)
2003        print(f"Repository:     {report['target_repo']} ({report['repo_slug'] or 'no slug'})")
2004        print(f"Authority:      {report['authority_profile']}")
2005        print(f"Stop reason:    {report['stop_reason']}")
2006        print(f"Attempted:      {', '.join(report['tasks_attempted']) or 'none'}")
2007        print(f"Completed:      {', '.join(report['tasks_completed']) or 'none'}")
2008        print(f"Failed:         {', '.join(report['tasks_failed']) or 'none'}")
2009        print(f"Parked:         {', '.join(report['tasks_parked']) or 'none'}")
2010        print(f"Duration:       {report['duration_seconds']}s")
2011        print(f"State:          {report['state_dir']}")
2012    # A parked task is not a failure: it is the control plane correctly
2013    # refusing to exceed its delegated authority, and the operator decides.
2014    return 0 if not report["tasks_failed"] else 1

2017def _handle_decision(args: argparse.Namespace, decision: str) -> int:
2018    target_repo = str(_resolve_repo(args))
2019    ledger_file = _resolve_ledger_file(args)
2020    ledger = EvidenceLedger(ledger_file) if ledger_file else None
2021    fn = HumanLifecycleManager.approve if decision == "approved" else HumanLifecycleManager.reject
2022    record = fn(
2023        target_repo=target_repo,
2024        task_id=args.task_id,
2025        reason=getattr(args, "reason", None),
2026        operator_source="cli",
2027        ledger=ledger,
2028    )
2029    if getattr(args, "json", False):
2030        print(record.to_json())
2031    else:
2032        title = "TASK AUTHORIZED" if decision == "approved" else "TASK REJECTED"
2033        print("=" * 60)
2034        print(f"HOWLPLANE — {title}: {record.task_id}")
2035        print("=" * 60)
2036        print(f"Task:               {record.task_id}")
2037        print(f"Decision:           {decision.upper()}")
2038        print(f"Timestamp:          {record.timestamp}")
2039        if record.reason:
2040            print(f"Reason:             {record.reason}")
2041        if decision == "approved":
2042            print("")
2043            print("Next Action:")
2044            print(f"  howlplane resume {record.task_id}")
2045        else:
2046            print("Terminal state:     FAILED (Rejected)")
2047        print("=" * 60)
2048    return 0
