def cmd_marathon(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
1922def cmd_marathon(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
1923    """Works a bounded sequence of the target repository's ranked backlog."""
1924    import json as _json
1925    import sys as _sys
1926    from howlplane.control_plane.backlog_source import BacklogSource
1927    from howlplane.control_plane.synthesis import MarathonDogfoodEngine
1928    from howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool import ProviderPoolManager
1929
1930    target_repo = getattr(args, "target_repo", None) or "."
1931
1932    if getattr(args, "dry_run", False):
1933        # Read-only: shows exactly which items are eligible and why the
1934        # near-misses are not, without binding an authority envelope or
1935        # invoking any provider.
1936        selection = BacklogSource(
1937            target_repo, roi_floor=getattr(args, "roi_floor", 0.5)
1938        ).select()
1939        payload = {
1940            "target_repo": target_repo,
1941            "files_read": selection.files_read,
1942            "eligible": [item.to_dict() for item in selection.eligible],
1943            "excluded": selection.excluded,
1944            "would_work": [
1945                item.task_id for item in selection.eligible[: args.max_tasks]
1946            ],
1947        }
1948        if getattr(args, "json", False):
1949            print(_json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
1950        else:
1951            print("=" * 60)
1952            print(f"HOWLPLANE — MARATHON DRY RUN: {target_repo}")
1953            print("=" * 60)
1954            print(f"Backlogs read:      {', '.join(selection.files_read) or 'none'}")
1955            print(f"Eligible items:     {len(selection.eligible)}")
1956            print(f"Would work (max {args.max_tasks}):")
1957            for item in selection.eligible[: args.max_tasks]:
1958                print(f"  - {item.task_id}  score={item.score}  {item.title}")
1959            if selection.excluded:
1960                print("\nPending but NOT eligible:")
1961                for excluded in selection.excluded:
1962                    print(f"  - #{excluded['item_id']} ({excluded['source_file']}): {excluded['reason']}")
1963            print("\nNo provider was invoked and nothing was written.")
1964        return 0
1965
1966    ledger = EvidenceLedger(args.ledger_file) if getattr(args, "ledger_file", None) else None
1967    engine = MarathonDogfoodEngine(
1968        provider_pool=ProviderPoolManager.from_config(),
1969        ledger=ledger,
1970        campaign_dir=getattr(args, "campaign_dir", None),
1971        target_repo=target_repo,
1972        repo_slug=getattr(args, "repo_slug", None),
1973    )
1974    report = engine.run_backlog_marathon(
1975        authority_profile_id=args.authority_profile,
1976        max_tasks=args.max_tasks,
1977        max_runtime_hours=args.max_runtime_hours,
1978        resume_campaign_id=getattr(args, "resume", None),
1979        roi_floor=getattr(args, "roi_floor", 0.5),
1980    )
1981
1982    if report.get("refused"):
1983        # Fail-closed preflight: the campaign never started. Reported on stderr
1984        # with a non-zero exit so an unattended wrapper cannot read it as a run
1985        # that simply found nothing to do.
1986        if getattr(args, "json", False):
1987            print(_json.dumps(report, indent=2))
1988        else:
1989            print("=" * 60, file=_sys.stderr)
1990            print("HOWLPLANE — MARATHON REFUSED", file=_sys.stderr)
1991            print("=" * 60, file=_sys.stderr)
1992            print(report["refusal_reason"], file=_sys.stderr)
1993            print("\nWorking tree changes found:", file=_sys.stderr)
1994            for path in report["dirty_files"]:
1995                print(f"  {path}", file=_sys.stderr)
1996        return 2
1997
1998    if getattr(args, "json", False):
1999        print(_json.dumps(report, indent=2))
2000    else:
2001        print("=" * 60)
2002        print(f"HOWLPLANE — BACKLOG MARATHON: {report['campaign_id']}")
2003        print("=" * 60)
2004        print(f"Repository:     {report['target_repo']} ({report['repo_slug'] or 'no slug'})")
2005        print(f"Authority:      {report['authority_profile']}")
2006        print(f"Stop reason:    {report['stop_reason']}")
2007        print(f"Attempted:      {', '.join(report['tasks_attempted']) or 'none'}")
2008        print(f"Completed:      {', '.join(report['tasks_completed']) or 'none'}")
2009        print(f"Failed:         {', '.join(report['tasks_failed']) or 'none'}")
2010        print(f"Parked:         {', '.join(report['tasks_parked']) or 'none'}")
2011        print(f"Duration:       {report['duration_seconds']}s")
2012        print(f"State:          {report['state_dir']}")
2013    # A parked task is not a failure: it is the control plane correctly
2014    # refusing to exceed its delegated authority, and the operator decides.
2015    return 0 if not report["tasks_failed"] else 1

Works a bounded sequence of the target repository's ranked backlog.

def cmd_unlock(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
2129def cmd_unlock(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
2130    """Reclaims the locks holding a task back, when their owners are gone.
2131
2132    The one explicit, audited takeover path. `ai resume` deliberately keeps its
2133    fail-closed behavior, so nothing ever steals a lock implicitly; a person
2134    asks for this, and the reclamation is recorded (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
2135    Both the task-run lock and the repository lock are inspected, so what this
2136    command acts on matches what `ai status` reports (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).
2137    """
2138    from howlplane.control_plane.locking import (
2139        LockError,
2140        classify_lock_owner,
2141        reclaim_lock,
2142    )
2143    from howlplane.control_plane.atomic_io import safe_load_json
2144
2145    target_repo = str(_resolve_repo(args))
2146    ledger_file = _resolve_ledger_file(args)
2147    ledger = EvidenceLedger(ledger_file) if ledger_file else None
2148    as_json = bool(getattr(args, "json", False))
2149
2150    def audit(action, result, artifact=None, metadata=None):
2151        if ledger is None:
2152            return
2153        ledger.append_entry(
2154            EvidenceEntry(
2155                task_id=args.task_id,
2156                agent_id="human_operator",
2157                action=action,
2158                command=f"ai unlock {args.task_id}",
2159                result=result,
2160                artifact=artifact,
2161                repository=str(target_repo),
2162                metadata=metadata or {},
2163            )
2164        )
2165
2166    audit("unlock_requested", "REQUESTED")
2167
2168    inspected = []
2169    reclaimed = []
2170    refusals = []
2171
2172    for label, lock_path in _lock_candidates(target_repo, args.task_id):
2173        if not lock_path.exists():
2174            continue
2175        try:
2176            owner = safe_load_json(lock_path)
2177        except Exception as err:
2178            refusals.append(f"{label} lock at '{lock_path}' is unreadable: {err}")
2179            continue
2180
2181        relevant, why_not = _lock_relevance(owner, args.task_id)
2182        state, reason = classify_lock_owner(
2183            owner.get("pid", -1),
2184            owner.get("hostname", ""),
2185            owner.get("process_create_time", 0.0),
2186        )
2187        inspected.append(
2188            {
2189                "scope": label,
2190                "path": str(lock_path),
2191                "owner_state": state.value,
2192                "reason": reason,
2193                "relevant": relevant,
2194                "pid": owner.get("pid"),
2195                "hostname": owner.get("hostname"),
2196                "operation": owner.get("operation"),
2197                "task_id": owner.get("task_id"),
2198            }
2199        )
2200
2201        if not as_json:
2202            print(f"{label.capitalize()} lock: {lock_path}")
2203            print(
2204                f"  Owner: pid {owner.get('pid')} @ {owner.get('hostname')} "
2205                f"({owner.get('command')}) -- {state.value}"
2206            )
2207            print(f"  {reason}")
2208
2209        if not relevant:
2210            msg = f"Refusing to reclaim {label} lock: {why_not}."
2211            refusals.append(msg)
2212            if not as_json:
2213                print(f"  {msg}")
2214            audit(
2215                "unlock_refused",
2216                "NOT_THIS_TASK",
2217                artifact=str(lock_path),
2218                metadata={"scope": label, "reason": why_not},
2219            )
2220            continue
2221
2222        try:
2223            record = reclaim_lock(lock_path)
2224        except LockError as err:
2225            refusals.append(str(err))
2226            if not as_json:
2227                print(f"  ERROR: {err}")
2228            audit(
2229                "unlock_refused",
2230                state.value,
2231                artifact=str(lock_path),
2232                metadata={"scope": label, "reason": str(err)},
2233            )
2234            continue
2235
2236        payload = record.to_dict()
2237        payload["scope"] = label
2238        reclaimed.append(payload)
2239        # Keeps the established ledger vocabulary rather than introducing a
2240        # second name for the same event.
2241        audit(
2242            "stale_lock_reclaimed",
2243            record.owner_state,
2244            artifact=record.lock_path,
2245            metadata=payload,
2246        )
2247        if not as_json:
2248            print(f"  Reclaimed {record.owner_state} {label} lock.")
2249
2250    if as_json:
2251        import json
2252        print(
2253            json.dumps(
2254                {
2255                    "task_id": args.task_id,
2256                    "inspected": inspected,
2257                    "reclaimed": reclaimed,
2258                    "refused": refusals,
2259                },
2260                indent=2,
2261            )
2262        )
2263
2264    if not inspected:
2265        if not as_json:
2266            print(f"No locks held for '{args.task_id}'. Nothing to reclaim.")
2267        audit("unlock_requested", "NO_OP")
2268        return 0
2269
2270    if reclaimed:
2271        if not as_json:
2272            print(f"You can now run: howlplane resume {args.task_id}")
2273        return 0
2274
2275    return 1 if refusals else 0

Reclaims the locks holding a task back, when their owners are gone.

The one explicit, audited takeover path. ai resume deliberately keeps its fail-closed behavior, so nothing ever steals a lock implicitly; a person asks for this, and the reclamation is recorded (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05). Both the task-run lock and the repository lock are inspected, so what this command acts on matches what ai status reports (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).

def cmd_factory_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
2561def cmd_factory_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
2562    from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
2563    import signal
2564    import threading
2565
2566    refused = _factory_preflight(args)
2567    if refused is not None:
2568        return refused
2569    campaign = _resolve_factory_campaign(args, prepare=True)
2570    if campaign is not None:
2571        _select_factory_authority(args, campaign)
2572    wake = threading.Event()
2573    supervisor = _build_factory_supervisor(args, sleep=wake.wait)
2574
2575    def request_stop(signum, _frame):
2576        supervisor.request_stop(f"signal_{signal.Signals(signum).name.lower()}")
2577        wake.set()
2578
2579    until = None
2580    if getattr(args, "until", None):
2581        until = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=args.until)
2582    previous = {}
2583    try:
2584        for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT):
2585            previous[sig] = signal.signal(sig, request_stop)
2586        if getattr(args, "resume_stopped", False):
2587            supervisor.run(until=until, resume_stopped=True)
2588        else:
2589            supervisor.run(until=until)
2590    finally:
2591        for sig, handler in previous.items():
2592            signal.signal(sig, handler)
2593    status = supervisor.status()
2594    if getattr(args, "json", False):
2595        import json
2596        print(json.dumps({"status": status}, indent=2, default=str))
2597    else:
2598        print(f"Factory stopped. State: {status['state']}")
2599        print(f"Run mode: {status.get('run_mode', 'continuous')}")
2600        if status.get('max_work_items') is not None:
2601            print(f"Work item limit: {status['max_work_items']}")
2602            print(f"Work items dispatched: {status.get('work_items_dispatched', 0)}")
2603            remaining = max(0, (status['max_work_items'] or 0) - (status.get('work_items_dispatched') or 0))
2604            print(f"Remaining: {remaining}")
2605        print(f"Stopped reason: {status['stopped_reason']}")
2606        print(f"Dispatches: {status['dispatch_history_count']}")
2607        print(f"Completed: {len(status['recent_completed'])}")
2608        print(f"Failed: {len(status['recent_failed'])}")
2609    return 0

def cmd_factory_stop(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
2744def cmd_factory_stop(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
2745    from howlplane.control_plane.factory.campaign import campaign_from_state_dir
2746    from howlplane.control_plane.factory.supervisor_state import SupervisorState
2747    campaign = _resolve_factory_campaign(args)
2748    if campaign is None:
2749        campaign = campaign_from_state_dir(args.state_dir)
2750    if campaign is not None:
2751        from howlplane.control_plane.factory.service import stop_process
2752        # Persisting STOPPED first makes a crash during backend shutdown fail
2753        # closed. The run loop receives SIGTERM and reconciles its active tick.
2754        store = _factory_state_store(args)
2755        record = store.load(reconcile_restart=False)
2756        if record.state != SupervisorState.STOPPED:
2757            record.transition_to(SupervisorState.STOPPED, reason="operator_stop")
2758            record.stopped_reason = "operator_stop"
2759            store.save(record)
2760        print(stop_process(campaign))
2761        return 0
2762    store = _factory_state_store(args)
2763    record = store.load()
2764    if record.state == SupervisorState.STOPPED:
2765        print("Already stopped.")
2766        return 0
2767    record.transition_to(SupervisorState.STOPPED, reason="operator_stop")
2768    record.stopped_reason = "operator_stop"
2769    store.save(record)
2770    print("Factory supervisor stopped.")
2771    return 0
def cmd_factory_resume(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
2774def cmd_factory_resume(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
2775    from howlplane.control_plane.factory.supervisor_state import SupervisorState
2776    store = _factory_state_store(args)
2777    record = store.load()
2778    if record.state != SupervisorState.STOPPED:
2779        print(f"Factory supervisor is not stopped (state={record.state}).")
2780        return 1
2781    record.transition_to(SupervisorState.IDLE, reason="operator_resume")
2782    record.stopped_reason = None
2783    store.save(record)
2784    print("Factory supervisor resumed.")
2785    return 0
def cmd_factory_start(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
2788def cmd_factory_start(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
2789    """Normal persistent Factory entrypoint over the existing run loop."""
2790    from howlplane.control_plane.factory.service import start_process
2791
2792    refused = _factory_preflight(args)
2793    if refused is not None:
2794        return refused
2795    campaign = _resolve_factory_campaign(args, prepare=True, force_resolve=True)
2796    profile = _select_factory_authority(args, campaign)
2797    # Bind the selected existing envelope before detaching. This keeps the
2798    # operator choice durable even if the new backend exits before its first
2799    # tick, while still using the same supervisor builder and authority path.
2800    _build_factory_supervisor(args)
2801    start_kwargs = {}
2802    if getattr(args, "max_work_items", None) is not None:
2803        start_kwargs["max_work_items"] = args.max_work_items
2804    started, record = start_process(
2805        campaign, profile, getattr(args, "objective", None), **start_kwargs
2806    )
2807    display_authority = "safe" if profile == "strict" else profile
2808    if getattr(args, "json", False):
2809        import json
2810        print(json.dumps({"started": started, "campaign_id": campaign.repository.campaign_id,
2811                          "state_dir": str(campaign.state_dir), "target_repo": str(campaign.target_dir),
2812                          "backend": record.backend, "authority": display_authority}, indent=2))
2813        return 0
2814    if not started:
2815        print("Factory is already running.\n")
2816        print(f"Project: {campaign.repository.remote or campaign.repository.root.name}")
2817        print("Use `howlplane factory status` for details.")
2818        return 0
2819    print("HowlPlane Factory\n")
2820    print(f"Project: {campaign.repository.remote or campaign.repository.root.name}")
2821    if campaign.repository.dirty:
2822        print("Working tree contains local changes. Your checkout will not be modified.")
2823    print(f"Factory target: {campaign.target_dir}")
2824    print(f"Authority: {display_authority}")
2825    print(f"Backend: {record.backend}")
2826    print("\nFactory started.\n\nUse:\n  howlplane factory status\n  howlplane factory logs --follow\n  howlplane factory stop")
2827    return 0

3073    cmd = ["bash", str(run_script)]
3074    if port:
3075        cmd.append(str(port))
3076
3077    print(f"Launching verified product in {product_dir}...")
3078    try:
3079        res = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(product_dir))
3080        return res.returncode
3081    except KeyboardInterrupt:
3082        print("\nServer stopped.")
3083        return 0

Executes a verified product bundle.

3087    """
3088    Read-only dogfood campaign inspection (#58 Phase 1). Loads durable campaign
3089    state directly from disk and reports it. Never constructs a provider pool,
3090    never probes agent binaries/services, never invokes a provider, never
3091    synthesizes a product, and never mutates the persisted campaign scope.

3094
3095    campaign_id = args.status
3096    campaign_dir = Path(getattr(args, "campaign_dir", ".dogfood_runs") or ".dogfood_runs") / campaign_id
3097    try:
3098        state = DurableCampaignState.load(campaign_dir)
3099    except FileNotFoundError:

3101        return 1
3102
3103    if getattr(args, "json", False):
3104        import json
3105        print(json.dumps(state.to_dict(), indent=2))
3106    else:
3107        print(state.render_markdown())
3108        pending = [
3109            b for b in state.requested_benchmarks
3110            if b not in {h.get("benchmark_id") for h in state.benchmark_history if h.get("success")}
3111        ]
3112        print("\n## Status Inspection (read-only; no provider invoked)\n")

3114        print(f"- Next action: {state.next_action}")
3115    return 0

3157def cmd_acceptance(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
3158    """
3159    Live governed-integration acceptance canary (#59.2 Phases 15-18).
3160    `ai acceptance overnight-integration` runs exactly one bounded governed
3161    engineering task -- through the real GovernedTaskOrchestrator, real
3162    independent review, real deterministic verification, and real
3163    GitIntegrationExecutor branch/commit/push/PR/CI/merge/remote-verify/
3164    local-sync lifecycle -- to prove that lifecycle end-to-end with no
3165    mocked git/gh boundary. The task is mechanically scoped to touch only
3166    its designated evidence artifact under documentation/task_journals/.
3167    """
3168    if getattr(args, "acceptance_action", None) != "overnight-integration":
3169        print("Usage: ai acceptance overnight-integration --authority-profile <strict|overnight-safe>")
3170        return 1
3171
3172    from howlplane.control_plane.synthesis import MarathonDogfoodEngine
3173    from howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool import ProviderPoolManager
3174
3175    ledger = EvidenceLedger(args.ledger_file) if getattr(args, "ledger_file", None) else None
3176    engine = MarathonDogfoodEngine(
3177        provider_pool=ProviderPoolManager.from_config(),
3178        campaign_dir=getattr(args, "campaign_dir", None),
3179        target_repo=getattr(args, "target_repo", None) or ".",
3180        repo_slug=getattr(args, "repo_slug", None),
3181        ledger=ledger,
3182    )
3183    result = engine.run_acceptance_canary(authority_profile_id=args.authority_profile)
3184    git_rec = result.get("git_record") or {}
3185    fully_verified = bool(
3186        git_rec.get("merged") and git_rec.get("remote_main_contains_merge") and git_rec.get("local_main_synced")
3187    )
3188
3189    if getattr(args, "json", False):
3190        import json
3191        print(json.dumps({**result, "fully_verified": fully_verified}, indent=2))
3192    else:
3193        print("=" * 60)
3194        print(f"HOWLPLANE — LIVE ACCEPTANCE CANARY: {result['campaign_id']}")
3195        print("=" * 60)
3196        print(f"Task ID:            {result['task_id']}")
3197        print(f"Journal path:       {result['journal_path']}")
3198        print(f"Task success:       {result['task_success']}")
3199        print(f"Branch:             {git_rec.get('branch')}")
3200        print(f"Commit SHA:         {git_rec.get('commit_sha')}")
3201        print(f"PR:                 #{git_rec.get('pr_number')} {git_rec.get('pr_url') or ''}")
3202        print(f"CI status:          {git_rec.get('ci_status')}")
3203        print(f"Merged:             {git_rec.get('merged')}")
3204        print(f"Merge SHA:          {git_rec.get('merge_sha')}")
3205        print(f"Remote verified:    {git_rec.get('remote_main_contains_merge')}")
3206        print(f"Local synced:       {git_rec.get('local_main_synced')}")
3207        if git_rec.get("failure_reason"):
3208            print(f"Failure reason:     {git_rec.get('failure_reason')}")
3209        print(f"Fully verified:     {fully_verified}")
3210        print("=" * 60)
3211
3212    return 0 if fully_verified else 1

Live governed-integration acceptance canary (#59.2 Phases 15-18). ai acceptance overnight-integration runs exactly one bounded governed engineering task -- through the real GovernedTaskOrchestrator, real independent review, real deterministic verification, and real GitIntegrationExecutor branch/commit/push/PR/CI/merge/remote-verify/ local-sync lifecycle -- to prove that lifecycle end-to-end with no mocked git/gh boundary. The task is mechanically scoped to touch only its designated evidence artifact under documentation/task_journals/.

def cmd_local(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
3256def cmd_local(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
3257    """
3258    Local (Ollama) model utilities (#58 Phase 3). `ai local setup`:
3259      1. checks whether Ollama is installed
3260      2. installs it via the official installer if missing and the operator
3261         confirms (or if HOWLPLANE_LOCAL_AUTO_INSTALL=1 is set)
3262      3. pulls the canonical model
3263      4. verifies with `ollama list`
3264      5. performs a tiny real inference ("Respond only with LOCAL_OK")
3265      6. reports PASS/FAIL with duration and observed details
3266
3267    Never pulls any model other than the one requested (default:
3268    qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct), and never installs anything beyond the
3269    official Ollama runtime.
3270    """
3271    import shutil as _shutil
3272    import subprocess as _subprocess
3273    import time as _time
3274
3275    from howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution import OllamaLocalBackend, diagnose_ollama
3276    from howlplane.control_plane.task_spec import TaskSpec
3277
3278    model = getattr(args, "model", "qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct")
3279    report: Dict[str, Any] = {"model": model, "steps": []}
3280
3281    def _step(name: str, ok: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
3282        report["steps"].append({"name": name, "ok": ok, "detail": detail})
3283        symbol = "OK" if ok else "FAIL"
3284        print(f"[{symbol}] {name}{': ' + detail if detail else ''}")
3285
3286    if not _shutil.which("ollama"):
3287        auto_install = os.environ.get("HOWLPLANE_LOCAL_AUTO_INSTALL") == "1"
3288        if not auto_install:
3289            _step(
3290                "ollama_installed", False,
3291                "Ollama is not installed. Re-run with HOWLPLANE_LOCAL_AUTO_INSTALL=1 to "
3292                "install it via the official installer (curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh), "
3293                "or install it yourself first.",
3294            )
3295            report["result"] = "FAIL"
3296            _print_local_report(args, report)
3297            return 1
3298        try:
3299            _subprocess.run(  # nosec B602 - fixed official install command, no shell interpolation of user input
3300                ["bash", "-c", "curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh"],
3301                check=True, timeout=600,
3302            )
3303            _step("ollama_installed", True, "Installed via official installer")
3304        except Exception as exc:
3305            _step("ollama_installed", False, f"Install failed: {exc}")
3306            report["result"] = "FAIL"
3307            _print_local_report(args, report)
3308            return 1
3309    else:
3310        _step("ollama_installed", True, "Already on PATH")
3311
3312    diag = diagnose_ollama(model=model)
3313    if diag.reason == "OLLAMA_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE":
3314        _step("ollama_service", False, diag.detail)
3315        report["result"] = "FAIL"
3316        _print_local_report(args, report)
3317        return 1
3318    _step("ollama_service", diag.reason != "OLLAMA_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE", diag.detail)
3319
3320    if diag.reason == "MODEL_NOT_INSTALLED":
3321        try:
3322            _subprocess.run(["ollama", "pull", model], check=True, timeout=3600)
3323            _step("model_pulled", True, f"Pulled {model}")
3324        except Exception as exc:
3325            _step("model_pulled", False, str(exc))
3326            report["result"] = "FAIL"
3327            _print_local_report(args, report)
3328            return 1
3329    else:
3330        _step("model_pulled", True, "Already installed")
3331
3332    try:
3333        listing = _subprocess.run(["ollama", "list"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
3334        model_listed = model.split(":")[0] in listing.stdout
3335        _step("ollama_list", model_listed, listing.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if listing.stdout.strip() else "")
3336    except Exception as exc:
3337        _step("ollama_list", False, str(exc))
3338
3339    backend = OllamaLocalBackend(model=model)
3340    probe_task = TaskSpec(task_id="LOCAL-SETUP-PROBE", repository="howlplane", objective="local setup smoke test", risk_level="low", task_class="docs")
3341    t0 = _time.time()
3342    result = backend.execute(probe_task, cwd=".", prompt_override="Respond only with LOCAL_OK", timeout_seconds=120)
3343    elapsed = round(_time.time() - t0, 3)
3344    inference_ok = result.success and "LOCAL_OK" in result.stdout
3345    _step("inference_smoke_test", inference_ok, f"stdout={result.stdout.strip()!r} duration={elapsed}s")
3346
3347    report["result"] = "PASS" if inference_ok else "FAIL"
3348    report["duration_seconds"] = elapsed
3349    _print_local_report(args, report)
3350    return 0 if inference_ok else 1

Local (Ollama) model utilities (#58 Phase 3). ai local setup:

  1. checks whether Ollama is installed
  2. installs it via the official installer if missing and the operator confirms (or if HOWLPLANE_LOCAL_AUTO_INSTALL=1 is set)
  3. pulls the canonical model
  4. verifies with ollama list
  5. performs a tiny real inference ("Respond only with LOCAL_OK")
  6. reports PASS/FAIL with duration and observed details

Never pulls any model other than the one requested (default: qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct), and never installs anything beyond the official Ollama runtime.

def main(args: Optional[List[str]] = None, program_name: str = 'howlplane') -> int: 
3401def main(args: Optional[List[str]] = None, program_name: str = "howlplane") -> int:
3402    """Runs the canonical HowlPlane control plane launcher."""
3403    if args is None:
3404        args = sys.argv[1:]
3405    parser = build_parser(program_name=program_name)
3406    parsed_args = parser.parse_args(args)
3407
3408    if not parsed_args.subcommand:
3409        parser.print_help()
3410        return 1
3411
3412    handler = HANDLERS.get(parsed_args.subcommand)
3413    if not handler:
3414        parser.print_help()
3415        return 1
3416
3417    try:
3418        # One resolution point: an explicit --workspace-trust overrides config for
3419        # this process and every agent, session, and service it launches.
3420        from howlplane.control_plane import workspace_trust
3421        workspace_trust.set_cli_policy(getattr(parsed_args, "workspace_trust", None))
3422        # Fail fast on an invalid environment or config value, before any work starts.
3423        workspace_trust.resolve_policy()
3424        return handler(parsed_args)
3425    except ControlPlaneError as err:
3426        print(str(err), file=sys.stderr)
3427        return 1
3428    except Exception as err:
3429        print(f"ERROR: {err}", file=sys.stderr)
3430        return 1

Runs the canonical HowlPlane control plane launcher.
